verdict.rationale: Self-serve onboarding speed is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no signup flow, data import or migration wizard, or time-to-value claim. The Web API row-creation endpoints are developer building blocks rather than a founder-facing onboarding path. Configurable fields and dashboards are an adjacent customization feature, not evidence of a partner-free setup in under an hour.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner
